summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or committing. Changes: src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py (one Text object, clickable_ranges input before width, range_clicked('<name>') @click spans added last, early path has no click spans); src/textual/renderables/opacity.py (blended color merged into existing style so click metadata is kept); src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new: Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with bare DEFAULT_STYLES "height: 2;", reactives _active_tab_name and _bar_position, watch__active_tab_name animation, async on_key with Escape awaiting app.set_focus(None), action_range_clicked); docs/reference/tabs.md (single ::: directive); tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/test_tabs.py. Deviations to review: bar position uses displayed-tab indices so duplicate names still underline the active tab; letter search only applies to single-character keys; the layout resolver needed no change because its Edge already had size, min_size, and fraction defaults; an empty label is treated as a flexible edge by the resolver and renders as one space; no sandbox demo was added. Unverified: rich 11.2 behavior for Style meta merging and Text stylize, since the rich source was not available locally, and no tests were run.
